note: Fixed rubric for the Outcome Verification Loop. Changing any byte requires updating rubric/rubric.lock in a reviewed commit; the loop refuses to run gates against an unlocked rubric. Graders read this file; they never write it.

hard_gates.title: Every input row accounted for, idempotent, originals preserved, no silent drops, no invented values, ambiguity flagged, lineage inspectable, repairs pass original and drifted fixtures
State machine, idempotency, concurrency, intake authorization, outcome and memory guards
No credentials in the repository or in the live site's shipped assets
Live Pages site loads and its data snapshot points at the state branch's latest run
Published result files are byte-identical to the accepted computation
Live-site browser checks at 390, 768 and 1440 px (states, interactions, keyboard, reduced motion, axe, overflow, console)

subjective.title: Clear order of attention on every view
Restrained warm palette with clear roles; meaning never by colour alone
Motion explains change; reduced-motion alternative intact
Deliberate mobile, tablet and desktop compositions
Reads as a precise transformation workbench, not a generic dashboard
